issues.exact_quote: the new framework determines the assignment of class labels by (1) minimizing the energy function associated with positive similarity, and (2) maximizing the energy function associated with negative similarity.
issues.reason_zh: 框架传播节点类别并用正负相似性能量决定标签分配；未说明扩展must-link/cannot-link监督关系，普通节点标签传播不等于成对约束传播。
